data.name: ViveTool_PageDescription
data.value: Tanganya inyandiko z’ibintu bya Windows uzamufasha ViVeTool. Shaka cyangwa kosa ibitangaza bikorwa mu bushobozi bwacyanje bwa Windows.

data.name: ViveTool_WarningMessage
data.value: Inshingano ikomeye: Gutanganya inyandiko z’ibintu bya Windows bishobora gusohora Windows Update, applications, drivers n'ubuzima bw'umuhanzi. Shaka igice cy'icyemezo kwayongera mbere yose. Tanganya gusa Inyandiko z’ibintu bya Windows zikoreshejwe kandi zishobora kubonwa. Ubwandiko bwinshi buhanganira kugenda ku restart kandi bushobora kuba bitangirika nta gukoresha igice cy'icyemezo kigufiwe.

data.name: ViveTool_ViveToolNotFound
data.value: ViVeTool itabonawe. Shaka cyangwa gushikisha igice cya ViVeTool kigizwe umutima w'ubwizerwa.

data.name: ViveTool_ViveToolError
data.value: Ikibazo mu gukemura ubuzima bwa ViVeTool

data.name: ViveTool_SearchPlaceholder
data.value: Shira itegurire cy'ID cyangwa izina ryo gushakisha...

data.name: ViveTool_EnableFeatureFailed
data.value: Kwishaje gufasha mirimo ya {0}. Shobora kuguha umwanya w'uburenganzira bwa 'Administrator'.

data.name: ViveTool_DisableFeatureFailed
data.value: Kwishaje gufunga mirimo ya {0}. Shobora kuguha umwanya w'uburenganzira bwa 'Administrator'.

data.name: ViveTool_ExportNoFeatures
data.value: Hari ibintu bitandukanye ntizihariye kugira ngo bigashyirweho.

data.name: ViveTool_ImportFileDialogFilter
data.value: Inyandiko zose (*.*)|*.*|Inyandiko za JSON (*.json)|*.json|Inyandiko zo mu bury'umunsi (*.txt)|*.txt|Inyandiko za CSV (*.csv)|*.csv

data.name: ViveTool_ImportDescription
data.value: Shaka ingano z’ingano zikoreshwa muri bwinshi cyangwa kuri URL. Amakuru yashyigikije ni: JSON, CSV, cyangwa icyemezo gusa (ID imwe kuri buri nyandiko).

data.name: ViveTool_ImportUrlDescription
data.value: Andika URL yo shakisha ingano z'ingano zikoreshwa:

data.name: ViveTool_InvalidUrl
data.value: URL ntizivugwa neza. Shaka mu URL ikwiye.

data.name: ViveTool_PathDescription
data.value: Iki plugin ikoresha ViVeTool runtime yawo yakongerijwe ku bury'ubwite. Ushobora gutandukanya urugendo rwa gusa rw’Urugero rwa ViVeTool.exe; niba urugendo rwa gusa rugabanije, ntuzakoresheka cyangwa runtime y’umwanya wazwiye yakongerijwe mu masezerano yo kwinjiza.

data.name: ViveTool_MissingToolMessage
data.value: ViVeTool ntibonye. Tafuneze kugukoresha mu byemezo.

data.name: ViveTool_ImportConfigDialogFilter
data.value: Icyemezo cya JSON (*.json)|*.json|Icyemezo cy'CSV (*.csv)|*.csv|Icyemezo cy'Ubutumwa (*.txt)|*.txt|Ibintu byose (*.*)|*.*

data.name: ViveTool_ImportConfigDescription
data.value: Guhingira icyemezo cya ViVeTool ku buryuma bw'umunsi. Ibi bizakoresha ibikorwa bya gusesengura (feature flags) n'icyemezo cyacyayo.

data.name: ViveTool_ConfigImportSuccessMessage
data.value: Byihunga guhingira icyemezo cya ibikorwa bya gusesengura {0} ku buryuma bw'umunsi {1}
